svg.text: Single-node K3s on the existing Ubuntu VM - based on production-cloud scripts
Kubernetes cluster: K3s | one server node (control plane + workloads)
Node: reloop-vm | Ubuntu 24.04 | container runtime: containerd
Namespace: reloop-production | logical resource grouping (not a separate machine)
Existing VM reverse proxy / TLS termination
Upstreams: frontend and gateway published host ports
No separate review-service in this profile
Source: deploy/production-cloud/k8s-production.py (manifests, public_ports, FILES) and README.md. Configuration review only; live cluster not inspected.
This profile uses hostPort + hostPath and disables Traefik / ServiceLB. It does not use Ingress, StatefulSets or PVCs. Host ports come from deployment config.
Cloudflare and the existing origin proxy are retained from the original topology; verify their live route/TLS settings. Blue arrows = communication; dashed arrow = management.
All cards contain Kubernetes Service + Pod + Container. Deployment ownership and hostPath mounts are stated as annotations to keep the traffic view readable.
